parts.text: I want to buy 2 wireless headphones. Wait, actually, make it just 1 headphone and add 1 Bluetooth speaker instead.
Let's order a mechanical keyboard and apply the promo code SAVE20. Oh wait, I changed my mind—please remove the promo code.
I need to purchase a smart watch and apply the discount code STUDENT50. Wait, nevermind about the watch, I just want a tablet instead. Does the promo code still work?
